heading: cyAdd a payment
paragraphs: cyEnter a payment the defendants made towards the rent due on {{periodDue}} ({{periodAmount}}).

errors.amountPaidInvalid: cyEnter the amount paid as an amount of money, like 500 or 500.50

date.required: cyEnter the date the payment was made
date.notRealDate: cyThe date the payment was made must be a real date
date.invalidValue: cyThe date the payment was made must be a real date
date.futureDate: cyThe date the payment was made must be today or in the past
date.missingOne: cyThe date the payment was made must include a {{missingField}}
date.missingTwo: cyThe date the payment was made must include a {{first}} and {{second}}

errors.beforeDateDue: cyThe date the payment was made must be the same as or after {{dateDue}}, the date this rent was due
